state.identity: TenantId plus normalized operational process name
state.selected_invariant: One normalized active process name is held by at most one operational process in a tenant.
state.holder_rule: A holder is an operational process stream in the same tenant, in the inventory-registers area, with an operational-process resource and non-empty process UUID.
state.implementation: Claim and release validate holder identity before raising events. Both claim and release reducers validate the holder identity during replay. NameClaim keeps shared name occupancy and exact holder-generation checks; this feature owner adds operational-process-specific stream identity checks.
state.exclusions: This review does not infer a policy for which names may be reused or authorize changes to process lifecycle.

type_specific_holder_guard.instructions: Does the selected invariant justify keeping the operational-process tenant, area, and resource identity check in OperationalProcessNameClaim, including both command-time checks and replay checks, rather than moving it into the generic NameClaim base? Answer true when the guard is specific to this owner and protects its selected identity.
